verses.text: Ex wetisraelal, ab'ek slolonel Jehová. Wan yalan Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto manhxalaj mach tz'elk'och tas syala'. Manhxalaj mach wach'to spensar, manhxalaj mach syak'och spensar t'ay.
Sk'echaanh heb' sk'exan sti' t'a tas syala', syesan heb'. Smilwaj heb', tz'elk'an heb', anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb'. Slaj yixtej yetanimail heb', kotak skal smilancham anima heb'.
Yuj chi', a slum jun chonhab' tik, ol kan tzinan. Ha heb' kajan t'ay, manhxalaj yip heb'. Ol cham nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.
Syalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Malajokab' mach skot yowal t'a heb' chonhab' tik, yujto a mach ay wowal yet'ok haton eyet' ex sacerdote.
Yuj chi', ha t'a k'ualil ol ex telwok icha t'ak'walil. Ol telwok pax heb' in chekab' heyet'ok. Ha in ol wak' lajwok chonhab' Israel to icha he nun yaji.

Ol in satel jun in chonhab' tik, yujto manhxo in naanok yuj. Ha exxo ex sacerdote, yelxo maxtzak in he na'a. Yuj chi' ol ex wik'el t'a eyopisio. Yujto ix b'at in k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal eyuuj, yuj chi' manhxo ol in nakot heb' eyinhtilal.
Icha ix aj sq'uib' he b'isul ex sacerdote, icha chi' ix aj sk'echaanh smul in chonhab'. Yuj chi' a he b'inajnakil, q'uixwelaltak ol wutejkani.
Yuj silab' syak' in chonhab' yuj smul, wach' he wa'i, yuj chi' tze nib'ej to tz'ochnhej smul in chonhab' tik t'ayin.
Yuj chi' lajan ol aj yab'an syail heb' in chonhab' heyet'ok a ex sacerdote ex tik. Yuj he b'eyb'al chi' ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh yet' heb'.

Yujto maxtzak in yak' serwil heb' in chonhab', haxo jun komon Dios skuch Baal syak' serwil heb'. Wach'chom swa heb', sway heb' yet' heb' ix ajmul ix t'a stemplo skomon diosal chi', palta manh yujok chi' niwan ol satan smunlajel heb', manh ol q'uib'pax sb'isul heb'.
Yuj yajmulal heb' yet' yuk'umanhil heb', yuj chi' ix kistalax spensar heb'.

Ha t'a junok te te' sk'anb'ej yab' heb' in chonhab' tik tas sk'ulej heb'. Haxo te te' chi' tz'ak'an srazón heb' yalani. Yuj yajmulal heb' chi', yuj chi' ix juwiel heb'. Icha wal tz'aj yaktankan winh yetb'eyum junok ix ix, smulan yet' junokxo winak, icha chi' ix in yutej heb', sb'atkan tzak'an heb' yuj komon Dios.

Ha t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak, hata' snhus incienso heb' yet' yak'an silab' heb' t'a yalanh yenhul xil te' álamo, te' ji yet' te' mach'. Yuj chi', slaj em heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' ix eyalib' t'a ajmulal.

Palta manh ol wak'ochlaj syaelal heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' ix eyalib' yuj yajmulal chi', yujto a ex jun tze k'ulej ajmulal chi', tzeyak'an silab' yet' heb' ix ix sb'eyb'alan ajmulal. Yuj chi', a jun chonhab' malaj spensar tik, ol ixtaxelok.

Wach'chom ix och smul chonhab' Israel, palta mokab' och smul chonhab' Judá. Mokab' b'at och heb' ejmelal t'a Gilgal, mokab' k'epax heb' t'a Bet-awén. Mokab' slok in b'i heb' a in Jehová pitzan in tik.
Ha chonhab' Israel, te pit, lajan wal icha junok nok' wakax te ow. Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol yal in tanhwan heb' icha junok nok' yune' kalnel b'aj yax ank'ultak?
Haxo chonhab' Efraín ix och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios, palta olxo yil sb'a.

Masanil heb' syal sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzek' tzuyjab' heb' t'a skal heb' yetuk'umanhil. Maxtzak yaktej heb' sk'ulan ajmulal. Ha heb' yajalil heb', a tas q'uixwelaltak snib'ej heb' sk'ulan t'a yichanh to tz'alji heb' wach'il.
Icha tz'aj yik'chajb'at k'alem yuj ik', icha chi' ol aj yik'chajb'at heb'. Malaj ol yak' yal heb' yuj juntzanh silab' syak' t'a juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.
